question: Should this broad platform-app umbrella stay open as the canonical Linux companion-app tracker now that Windows Hub is documented and released?
rationale: Current main and v2026.6.11 cover Windows Hub, but Linux companion support is still absent and the remaining implementation choices affect app stack, packaging, gateway credentials, node permissions, release assets, and docs ownership.

options.title: Keep As Linux Umbrella
options.body: Retain this issue for Linux companion-app direction while treating Windows Hub as partially completed context.

options.title: Adopt Desktop PR Direction
options.body: Sponsor the open Tauri desktop PR only after maintainer review resolves its security, packaging, proof, and scope risks.

options.title: Split Linux Milestones
options.body: Create or designate narrower Linux app issues and close this umbrella only after those canonical refs exist.

recommendation.title: Keep As Linux Umbrella
recommendation.body: Retain this issue for Linux companion-app direction while treating Windows Hub as partially completed context.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue's product-direction comments and CONTRIBUTING.md owner listing make steipete the clearest decision owner for broad companion-app strategy.
